create_error_response: create an error response with sanitized message, error type, and HTTP status code from an exception or string
build_with_cancellation: build a FastAPI route handler decorator that cancels the handler on client disconnection
test_load_aware_call: test the load-aware call decorator that tracks server load metrics and decrements on response completion
run_get_max_tokens: run a function that computes the maximum output tokens given model length, input length, and sampling params
summarize_log_non_default_args: summarize non-default CLI arguments from a Namespace or EngineArgs instance for logging
